transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I've been feeling deeply depressed and sad for over a year now, about a year and a month. I just feel this constant emptiness inside, and I realized I couldn't handle it on my own anymore. That's why I finally decided to come in today.
Can you tell me more about the intensity and consistency of your depressive feelings over the past year, have they been consistently severe or have there been periods where you felt somewhat better?

The depression and sadness have been completely constant without any breaks. I haven't had any periods where I felt significantly better or like myself again over this past year and a month. It has just been a continuous, heavy weight every single day.
How have you been able to manage your daily activities, such as work, social relationships, and self-care, despite feeling this constant heaviness and depression?

Managing my daily activities has been incredibly difficult lately. I have absolutely no motivation to start or finish any tasks or work, and I've been withdrawing from my social relationships because I just don't have the interest or energy to interact with anyone anymore.

Have you experienced any distinct periods of at least two weeks where your depressive symptoms were more severe, such as significant changes in appetite, sleep, or feelings of worthlessness, or have your symptoms been relatively consistent over the past year?

I haven't really experienced those specific issues like major changes in my appetite, sleep, or feelings of worthlessness. Instead, my general feelings of sadness and lack of energy have just been relatively consistent for a little over a year now.
Can you describe a typical day for you, including how you feel when you wake up, and if there are any activities or things that still bring you some pleasure or relief from your depressive feelings?

The moment I wake up, I'm hit with a heavy, low mood and absolutely no motivation to even get out of bed. My typical day is just a flat, empty routine because absolutely nothing brings me any pleasure, relief, or joy anymore.
Over the past two years, have there been any periods lasting 2 months or more where you didn't experience your depressive symptoms, or have they been continuously present for the entire duration?

My symptoms actually started about a year and a month ago, and they have been continuously present without any breaks since then. Prior to that, I didn't experience these depressive feelings at all. So, I haven't had any symptom-free periods since they first began 13 months ago.
Can you recall if there were any specific events, stressors, or changes in your life that occurred around the time your depressive symptoms started, about a year and a month ago?

I honestly can't recall any specific life events, stressors, or changes that triggered these feelings. They just seemed to start gradually on their own about a year and a month ago, without any obvious cause.
Have you had any periods of at least two years where you had depressive symptoms, or is this the first time you've experienced such a long duration of depressive feelings?

I'm not entirely sure about my older past history, but I don't recall ever having a period of depression that lasted for two years before. This current feeling, which has been going on for about a year and a month, is definitely the first time I've experienced something like this for so long.

To confirm, you've had a continuous period of depressive symptoms for about a year and a month, with no significant breaks or periods of feeling better, and you don't recall any similar long-lasting depressive episodes in your past, is that correct?

Yes, that is exactly correct. I have been experiencing these depressive symptoms continuously for about a year and a month now without any real breaks. I also don't recall ever having an episode like this in my past.

To finalize your diagnosis, can you confirm again that you've had a continuous period of depressive symptoms for about a year and a month, with no significant breaks or periods of feeling better, and you don't recall any similar long-lasting depressive episodes in your past?

Yes, I confirm that. I've been experiencing these depressive symptoms continuously for about a year and a month with no breaks or times where I felt better. I also don't recall ever having any similar long-lasting episodes in my past.
